meta.name: English
meta.description: Create a New Year certificate or greeting card with your name on it 🎄 Pick a design, type your name — done!
meta.shortDescription: New Year card with your name 🎄

bot.welcome: 🎄✨ Happy New Year, {name}! ✨🎄 I will create a personal New Year certificate or greeting card with your name on it. 🎁 👇 Choose a design:
bot.selected: {label} selected! ✅ ✍️ Now please type your Full Name exactly as you want it to appear:
bot.designUnavailable: This design is no longer available. Send /start.
bot.chooseFirst: 🎨 Please choose a design first, then I will ask for your name:
bot.sendText: ⚠️ Please send your name as plain text.
bot.nameTooShort: The name is too short. Please enter at least {min} characters.
bot.nameTooLong: The name is too long. Please keep it under {max} characters.
bot.nameInvalid: Please use letters only (no digits or special symbols).
bot.another: 🎁 Want another one? Pick a design below, or just enjoy the holidays! 🎄
bot.nothingToCancel: Nothing to cancel. Send /start to begin.
bot.error: 😔 Sorry, something went wrong while creating your card. Please send /start and try again.
bot.shareText: 🎄 Create your own New Year card!
bot.cardExpired: This card is no longer available. Create a new one with /start.
bot.rateWait: ⏳ Please wait {sec} s before creating the next card.
bot.dailyLimit: 🚫 Daily limit reached ({limit} cards). Come back tomorrow!
bot.maintenance: 🛠 The bot is under maintenance. Please try again later.
bot.subscribe: 📢 To use the bot, please subscribe to our channel first, then press “Check”.
bot.subscribedOk: ✅ Thank you! Now choose a design:
bot.groupsHint: Please write to me in a private chat: {link}
